messages:
nina: FYI - EU deploy slot 8821 tripped an alert during the 02:45 window: increased 503s from frontend -> orbit-router. I'm pausing downstream slots until we confirm cause.

deploy-bot: Release slot 8821 PAUSED by nina 178 - reason: eu controlplane 503 surge. Canary removed from rotation.

devin: What metrics showed the spike? p50/p95 or error rate?

nina: Primary signal is 5xx_rate spiking to ~2.2% at ~02:46 and a cluster of connection reset logs. Also seeing elevated KV cache evictions on those hosts.

ops-oncall: I'll pull controlplane + LB traces now. Seen a brief flurry of connection resets around 02:44-02:47 from orbit-router -> kv-proxy.

sre-olivia: Can we do a canary-swap to the last GA (v2.4.0) instead of a full rollback? If that stabilizes, requeue with a slow ramp and sticky pin for the EU window.

product-amber: Heads up, PMs want an update for customers if we extend the hold beyond 30m. Keep messaging tight.

devin: Prefer swap too. Also let's disable autoscaling for the slot during the staged requeue to avoid churn-related evictions.

nina: Agreed. Plan: 1) Swap canary on slot 8821 -> image v2.4.0. 2) Disable autoscaler for the slot. 3) Run smoke + 5 synthetic load checks. 4) If green, schedule staged requeue with sticky_pin=v2.4.0 for 1h and ramp [5%->20%->60%->100%]. Auto-pause if error_rate>0.8% OR p95>800ms.

deploy-bot: Executing canary swap: slot 8821 -> image v2.4.0 (requested by nina). Autoscaler=false for slot 8821. Scheduling smoke tests.

ops-oncall: Smoke run started 178 - 5 tests focused on inference happy path, auth flows, and soft-failure handling.

sre-olivia: Also enable kv-proxy debug logging for these hosts with label eu_release_probe for easy filtering for 30m.

deploy-bot: Smoke tests: 5/5 PASS for slot 8821. Canary swap completed. Sticky_pin applied for 3600s.

devin: Nice. Ops keep sampling traces for 10 more minutes, then decide on requeue. If evictions reappear we escalate to rollback.

ops-oncall: Sampling... so far no replication of the 503 spike on the reverted canary. Eviction rate dropped to baseline.

product-amber: Drafted a short customer blurb: "We paused EU releases due to transient controlplane 503s; canary reverted to v2.4.0 and we are running a staged requeue under observation. We'll send a follow-up update after the window." Thoughts?

nina: LGTM. deploy-bot schedule the staged requeue in +12m with the ramp and auto-pause thresholds noted. Also attach the exec pin so PMs can track.

deploy-bot: Requeue scheduled for slot 8821 in +12m with staged rollout [5% -> 20% -> 60% -> 100%], auto-pause thresholds: error_rate>0.8% OR p95_latency>800ms. Sticky_pin=v2.4.0 for 3600s. Notifying release owners and pm@.

sre-olivia: I'll keep kv-proxy tracing on for 30m and annotate any suspicious evictions.

devin: If we see a recurrence after the ramp hits 60%, we should throttle and open the incident review.

nina: Agreed. If green at +40m we lift the hold for the rest of the change window. ops, pls post final status at +40m.

ops-oncall: Will do. Current status: stabilizing, no fresh 503s on the swapped canary. Will update at +40m or earlier if it degrades. :thumbsup:
